name: llyfr
title: Llyfr
description: Search and manage a local BibTeX library of papers, and import entries and PDFs from NASA ADS.

commands.name: llyfr
commands.title: Search Library
commands.description: Display list of papers in the local library

preferences.name: api_token
preferences.title: ADS API Token

preferences.name: path
preferences.title: Path to the bibliography
preferences.description: Path to where all documents are stored

preferences.name: bibfile
preferences.title: Path to the .bib file
preferences.description: Path to the .bib file containing the bibliography
